# `arch/arm/include/arch_impl/armv7_mmu.h`

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

ARMv7-A short-descriptor translation table formats and MMU register fields.

```c
#include <arch_impl/armv7_mmu.h>
```
